<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>LIFE Indent & Stock Report 360</title>
<style>
.navbar{display:none}
.web-footer{display:none}

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --canvas:#E9F1EB; --panel:#FFFFFF; --panel2:#F5FAF6;
  --forest:#12492C; --deep:#0E3A23; --mid:#2C7A50; --mid2:#3E9268; --leaf:#6FBF44;
  --mint:#D9EBDF; --mint2:#EBF5EE; --band:#DFEDE3;
  --ink:#14301F; --ink2:#3C5748; --muted:#63806F;
  --rule:#BFD6C7; --rule2:#D7E8DC;
  --gold:#A67C00; --gold-bg:#FBF2D9; --gold-line:#DDC486; --gold-ink:#7A5B00;
  --teal:#1B6C76; --teal-bg:#DDEEF0; --teal-line:#AFD3D7;
  --alert:#A63A28; --alert-bg:#FAE6E1; --alert-line:#E7C0B6;
  --warn:#8E6408; --warn-bg:#FBF0D6; --warn-line:#E3CE96;
  --plum:#6A3B7A; --plum-bg:#F0E7F3;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(14,58,35,.10),0 6px 20px rgba(14,58,35,.09);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Segoe UI',Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;background:var(--canvas);color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
h1,h2,h3,.serif{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}
::selection{background:#BEE0CB}
button,input,select{font-family:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mid);outline-offset:1px}

/* ---------- TOP BAR ---------- */
.topbar{
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#0E3A23 0%,#17542F 45%,#2C7A50 100%);
  color:#fff;

  /* Leave space for LIFE Portal fullscreen back button */
  padding:0 15px 0 58px;

  height:56px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;

  position:sticky;
  top:0;
  z-index:400;

  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(14,58,35,.3);
}.brandmark{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0}
.brandmark span{color:var(--leaf)}
.tb-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3px;line-height:1.15}
.tb-sub{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);margin-top:1px}
.tb-right{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.tb-clock{font-size:10px;text-align:right;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);line-height:1.4}
.tb-user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.26);padding:4px 11px 4px 4px;border-radius:20px}
.tb-user .av{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#fff}
.tb-user .nm{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.1}
.tb-user .rl{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.pill{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:14px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600}
.cartbtn{position:relative;background:var(--gold);border:1px solid #C9A63B;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.cartbtn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.cartbtn .cn{background:#fff;color:var(--gold-ink);border-radius:11px;padding:0 7px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;min-width:20px;text-align:center}

/* ---------- TABS ---------- */
.tabbar{background:var(--panel);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);display:flex;align-items:stretch;position:sticky;top:56px;z-index:390;padding:0 12px}
.tab{border:none;background:none;padding:0 20px;height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;text-transform:uppercase}
.tab:hover{color:var(--forest);background:var(--mint2)}
.tab.on{color:var(--forest);border-bottom-color:var(--mid);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--mint2))}
.tab .cnt{font-size:10px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--forest);border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:1px 7px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800}
.tabbar .spacer{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding-right:2px}
.unit-toggle{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden}
.unit-toggle button{border:none;background:#fff;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}
.unit-toggle button.on{background:var(--mid);color:#fff}
.unit-toggle button+button{border-left:1px solid var(--rule)}
.page{display:none;padding:14px 15px 70px}
.page.on{display:block}

/* ---------- FILTERS ---------- */
.filterwrap{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:11px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:13px;overflow:hidden}
.fw-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 13px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--band),#fff);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.fw-head .t{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--forest);text-transform:uppercase}
.fw-head .hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.fw-body{padding:11px 13px 12px}
.frow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end}
.frow+.frow{margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--rule)}
.fld{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.fld label{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--ink2);text-transform:uppercase}
.fld select,.fld input{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 9px;font-size:12.5px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);min-width:132px}
.fld select:hover,.fld input:hover{border-color:var(--mid2)}
.searchfld{position:relative;flex:1 1 330px}
.searchfld input{width:100%;padding-left:30px;font-size:13px}
.searchfld .mag{position:absolute;left:9px;top:25px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.detect{margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink2);display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;min-height:18px}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:var(--mint);border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--forest);padding:2px 9px;border-radius:12px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.chip:hover{background:#CBE3D3}
.chip.gold{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold-ink)}
.chip.x{background:#fff}
.btn{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);padding:7px 13px;border-radius:7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--mid2);background:var(--mint2)}
.btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--mid2),var(--mid));border-color:var(--forest);color:#fff}
.btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.07)}
.btn.leaf{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--rule);color:var(--forest)}
.btn.gold{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold-ink)}
.btn.danger{background:var(--alert-bg);border-color:var(--alert-line);color:var(--alert)}
.btn.sm{padding:4px 9px;font-size:11px;border-radius:6px}
.reopen{display:none;width:100%;justify-content:center}
.reopen.on{display:flex}
.reopen button{width:150px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-top:none;border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;background:#fff;padding:4px 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--forest);cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}

/* ---------- FLOW SPINE ---------- */
.spine{display:flex;margin-bottom:13px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.step{flex:1 1 190px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:10px 15px 10px 25px;position:relative;min-width:180px}
.step:first-child{border-radius:11px 0 0 11px;padding-left:15px}
.step:last-child{border-radius:0 11px 11px 0}
.step+.step{border-left:none}
.step::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1px;top:0;bottom:0;width:13px;background:var(--canvas);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 50%,0 100%,0 0);z-index:2}
.step::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:1px;top:0;bottom:0;width:13px;background:var(--rule);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 50%,0 100%,0 0);z-index:1}
.step:first-child::before,.step:first-child::after{display:none}
.step .lbl{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.7px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.step .qty{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:23px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;margin-top:3px;color:var(--forest)}
.step .qty small{font-size:11px;font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.step .val{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;margin-top:1px}
.step .sub{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.step.s1{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--teal-bg));border-color:var(--teal-line)} .step.s1 .qty,.step.s1 .val{color:var(--teal)}
.step.s2{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--mint2))} .step.s2 .val{color:var(--mid)}
.step.s3{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--warn-bg));border-color:var(--warn-line)} .step.s3 .qty,.step.s3 .val{color:var(--warn)}
.step.s4{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--alert-bg));border-color:var(--alert-line)} .step.s4 .qty,.step.s4 .val{color:var(--alert)}
.step.s5{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--gold-bg));border-color:var(--gold-line)} .step.s5 .qty{color:var(--forest)} .step.s5 .val{color:var(--gold-ink)}

/* ---------- SECTIONS ---------- */
.sec{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.sec-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 13px;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--band) 0%,#fff 65%);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);user-select:none}
.sec-h:hover{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mint) 0%,#fff 72%)}
.sec-h .ar{font-size:10px;color:var(--mid);transition:transform .18s;width:12px;flex-shrink:0}
.sec.closed .sec-h{border-bottom-color:transparent}
.sec.closed .ar{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.sec.closed .sec-b{display:none}
.sec-h .ttl{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--deep);letter-spacing:.2px}
.sec-h .note{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);border-left:1px solid var(--rule);padding-left:10px}
.sec-h .rt{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.badge{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--forest);border:1px solid var(--rule);white-space:nowrap}
.badge.gold{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold-ink)}
.badge.alert{background:var(--alert-bg);border-color:var(--alert-line);color:var(--alert)}
.badge.teal{background:var(--teal-bg);border-color:var(--teal-line);color:var(--teal)}
.sec-b.pad{padding:12px 13px 14px}
.subhead{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--forest);padding:8px 13px 6px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule2);background:var(--panel2)}

/* ---------- TABLES ---------- */
.tw{overflow:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.tw.cap{max-height:470px}
table.rt{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;font-size:12.5px}
table.rt th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#E4F0E8,#D3E6DA);color:var(--deep);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:left;padding:8px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);border-right:1px solid #C9DED0;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;vertical-align:bottom}
table.rt th:hover{background:#C9E1D3}
table.rt th .sarr{opacity:.35;font-size:9px;margin-left:3px}
table.rt th.sorted .sarr{opacity:1;color:var(--forest)}
table.rt th.num,table.rt td.num{text-align:right}
table.rt td{padding:6px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);border-right:1px solid #EBF3EE;vertical-align:top;white-space:nowrap}
table.rt td.wrap{white-space:normal;word-break:break-word;line-height:1.35}
table.rt td.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
table.rt tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#F7FBF8}
table.rt tbody tr:hover{background:#E7F3EB}
table.rt tbody tr.clickable{cursor:pointer}
table.rt tbody tr.clickable:hover{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--mid)}
table.rt tfoot td{position:sticky;bottom:0;background:#DCEBE1;font-weight:800;color:var(--deep);border-top:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-bottom:none;z-index:4}
.nm{color:var(--deep);font-weight:700}
.lnk{color:var(--deep);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px dotted var(--mid)}
.lnk:hover{color:var(--mid);background:#E2F1E8}
.vlnk{color:var(--gold-ink);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px dotted var(--gold-line)}
.vlnk:hover{background:var(--gold-bg)}
.sub2{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;margin-top:1px}
.mono{font-family:Consolas,'Courier New',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink2)}
.alt{color:var(--plum);font-weight:700;font-size:11px}
.alt.single{color:var(--alert)}
.tag{display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid;white-space:nowrap}
.tag.ok{background:#DFF0E2;border-color:#B9DCC0;color:#1D6B31}
.tag.warn{background:var(--warn-bg);border-color:var(--warn-line);color:var(--warn)}
.tag.bad{background:var(--alert-bg);border-color:var(--alert-line);color:var(--alert)}
.tag.info{background:var(--teal-bg);border-color:var(--teal-line);color:var(--teal)}
.tag.mute{background:#EDF2EE;border-color:var(--rule);color:var(--ink2)}
.tag.plum{background:var(--plum-bg);border-color:#D7C2DE;color:var(--plum)}
.mv{display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid}
.mv.H{background:#DDF0E1;border-color:#A9D3B4;color:#155F2C}
.mv.M{background:var(--warn-bg);border-color:var(--warn-line);color:var(--warn)}
.mv.L{background:#E8EEF1;border-color:#C4D4DC;color:#3F5A68}
.money{color:var(--gold-ink);font-weight:700}
.inq{color:var(--teal);font-weight:700}
.outq{color:var(--mid);font-weight:700}
.retq{color:var(--warn);font-weight:700}
.dmg{color:var(--alert);font-weight:700}
.bal{color:var(--deep);font-weight:800}
.empty{padding:24px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px}
.empty b{display:block;color:var(--ink2);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
.addbtn{border:1px solid var(--gold-line);background:var(--gold-bg);color:var(--gold-ink);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.addbtn:hover{background:#F5E7BE}
.addbtn.inlist{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--rule);color:var(--forest)}

/* branch colours */
.b-HO{color:#8E6A00}.b-CN{color:#22683A}.b-SRN{color:#0F6A64}.b-MP{color:#5B3C86}.b-BH{color:#93356B}
.b-HN{color:#14549E}.b-DN{color:#A8551A}.b-GB{color:#0B6C7A}.b-VW{color:#4B7A22}.b-VZ{color:#6B4A33}
.b-NLR{color:#7A3FA8}.b-KP{color:#0A5F94}
.bdot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:5px;background:currentColor;vertical-align:middle}

/* ---------- BARS ---------- */
.barrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:130px 1fr 138px;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:3px 0}
.barrow .bn{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.bartrack{background:#E4EDE7;border-radius:5px;height:15px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.barfill{height:100%;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--mid),#5FB77F)}
.barfill.gold{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),#D9B84E)}
.barfill.teal{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),#5FA8B0)}
.barval{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink2)}
.rank{display:inline-flex;width:19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mint);color:var(--forest);align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;margin-right:6px;border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.rank.r1{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold-ink)}
.colchart{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:5px;height:118px;padding:6px 2px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.colchart .cbar{flex:1;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;min-width:0;height:100%}
.colchart .cb{width:46%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--mid),#6FB98D);border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;min-height:2px}
.colchart .cb.g{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),#E0C877)}
.colx{display:flex;gap:5px;padding-top:4px}
.colx div{flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}

/* ---------- 360 ---------- */
.pickbar{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:11px;padding:12px 13px;margin-bottom:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.pb-title{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:16px;color:var(--deep);font-weight:700}
.pb-sub{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 10px}
.sugg{position:absolute;z-index:60;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:0 0 9px 9px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);max-height:280px;overflow:auto;display:none}
.sugg.on{display:block}
.sugg div{padding:7px 11px;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.sugg div:hover{background:var(--mint2)}
.sugg .k{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--mint);color:var(--forest);border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.sugg .k.v{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold-ink)}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff 55%,var(--mint2));border:1px solid var(--rule);border-left:5px solid var(--mid);border-radius:11px;padding:14px 15px;display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero.vend{border-left-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fff 55%,var(--gold-bg))}
.pic{width:90px;height:90px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--mint),#fff);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:42px;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px #fff}
.pic.avatar{border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#D3AB3E,var(--gold));color:#fff;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:31px;font-weight:700}
.hero .hmain{flex:1 1 330px;min-width:270px}
.hero h2{font-size:21px;color:var(--deep);line-height:1.2}
.hero .hcode{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:3px;display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.hero .hmeta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:9px}
.mchip{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:8px;padding:5px 10px;min-width:96px}
.mchip .k{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.mchip .v{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--deep);margin-top:1px}
.mchip .s{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.mchip.gold{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-line)}
.mchip.gold .v{color:var(--gold-ink)}
.bigstock{flex:0 0 236px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 14px;text-align:right;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff,var(--gold-bg))}
.bigstock .k{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2)}
.bigstock .n{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:41px;font-weight:700;color:var(--deep);line-height:1.05;margin:2px 0}
.bigstock .n small{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif}
.bigstock .w{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold-ink)}
.bigstock .sp{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:4px;border-top:1px dashed var(--gold-line);padding-top:4px}
.hero{position:relative;align-items:stretch}
.hero .hmain{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.hero .hmeta{align-items:stretch}

/* --- time helpers (needed before data loads) --- */
const TODAY=new Date();

const iso=d=>d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
const MON=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
function dmy(s){if(!s)return '—';const d=new Date(s);if(isNaN(d))return '—';return String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+MON[d.getMonth()]+'-'+d.getFullYear()}
const daysBetween=(a,b)=>Math.round((new Date(b)-new Date(a))/864e5);
function ageText(f){const d=daysBetween(f,iso(TODAY)),y=Math.floor(d/365),m=Math.floor((d%365)/30);return (y?y+'y ':'')+m+'m'}
const THIS_M=iso(TODAY).slice(0,7);

/* --- globals populated from the API (declared, filled in loadLive) --- */
let BRANCHES=[],BR=[],BRANCH_USERS={},HO_MGR='HO Store';
let CATS=[],TYPES=[],T_GEN='',T_SPL='',T_STA='';
let ITEMS=[],VENDORS=[];
let PURCHASES=[],DRAFT_PURCHASES=[],DISPATCH=[],RETURNS=[],COMPLAINTS=[],PAYMENTS=[],ADJUST=[],BOOKINGS=[];
const itemVendors={};
/* Performance indexes: search and forecast never scan every transaction on every keystroke/cell. */
let SEARCH_ITEMS=[],SEARCH_VENDORS=[],SEARCH_DISPATCH_BY_REF={},SEARCH_PURCHASE_BY_REF={};
let DISPATCH_BY_ITEM={},PURCHASES_BY_ITEM={},LAST_RATE_MAP={};
let SEARCH_RENDER_TIMER=null,SEARCH_SUGGEST_TIMER=null,searchTimerGlobal=null;
// const HO_STOCK={},BRANCH_STOCK={},CONSUMED={},HO_DMG={},BR_DMG={},MOVE={};
const HO_STOCK={},BRANCH_STOCK={},CONSUMED={},HO_DMG={},BR_DMG={},MOVE={},PO_PENDING_MONTH={},PO_ORDERED_MONTH={};

/* --- lookup helpers (bound to live arrays) --- */
const bName=c=>{const b=BRANCHES.find(x=>x.code===c);return b?b.name:c};
const ITEM=c=>ITEMS.find(i=>i.code===c);
const VEN=c=>VENDORS.find(v=>v.code===c)||{code:c,name:c,phone:'',level:'',city:'',since:'',rm:'',rmPhone:'',terms:'',rating:0,blocked:false};
const branchTotal=ic=>BR.reduce((s,b)=>s+((BRANCH_STOCK[ic]&&BRANCH_STOCK[ic][b.code])||0),0);
const consumedTotal=ic=>BR.reduce((s,b)=>s+((CONSUMED[ic]&&CONSUMED[ic][b.code])||0),0);
const brDmgTotal=ic=>BR.reduce((s,b)=>s+((BR_DMG[ic]&&BR_DMG[ic][b.code])||0),0);
const dmgTotal=ic=>(HO_DMG[ic]||0)+brDmgTotal(ic);

const altCount=ic=>Math.max(0,(itemVendors[ic]||[]).length-1);

/* --- build derived positions from live payload --- */
function buildDerived(){
  /* HO_STOCK & BRANCH_STOCK come straight from live Bin (API). Here we only
     derive damage, consumption and movement class from live transactions. */
  ITEMS.forEach(it=>{
    const ic=it.code;
    HO_DMG[ic]=ADJUST.filter(a=>a.item===ic&&a.loc===HO_CODE).reduce((s,a)=>s+a.qty,0);
    if(!BRANCH_STOCK[ic])BRANCH_STOCK[ic]={};
    CONSUMED[ic]={};BR_DMG[ic]={};
    BR.forEach(b=>{
      const rec=DISPATCH.filter(d=>d.item===ic&&d.branch===b.code).reduce((s,d)=>s+d.qty,0);
      const rt=RETURNS.filter(r=>r.item===ic&&r.branch===b.code).reduce((s,r)=>s+r.qty,0);
      const dg=ADJUST.filter(a=>a.item===ic&&a.loc===b.code).reduce((s,a)=>s+a.qty,0);
      BR_DMG[ic][b.code]=dg;
      if(BRANCH_STOCK[ic][b.code]==null)BRANCH_STOCK[ic][b.code]=0;
      const onHand=BRANCH_STOCK[ic][b.code];
      /* consumed = received − returned − damaged − still on hand (never negative) */
      CONSUMED[ic][b.code]=Math.max(0,rec-rt-dg-onHand);
    });
    if(HO_STOCK[ic]==null)HO_STOCK[ic]=0;
  });
  /* movement class from consumption rank over the window */
  const rate=ITEMS.map(it=>({ic:it.code,v:consumedTotal(it.code)}));
  const sorted=rate.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v);
  sorted.forEach((r,i)=>{MOVE[r.ic]=i<sorted.length*0.3?'H':(i<sorted.length*0.7?'M':'L')});
  /* reorder level fallback from consumption if master safety_stock is 0 */
  ITEMS.forEach(it=>{
    if(!it.rl||it.rl<=0){const perMonth=consumedTotal(it.code)/6;it.rl=Math.max(1,Math.round(perMonth*0.8))}
  });
}

let HO_CODE='Stores - LSACPL';

/* --- adapt the API JSON into page globals --- */
function applyPayload(d){
  HO_CODE=(d.meta&&d.meta.ho_wh)||'Stores - LSACPL';
  /* branches: prepend a synthetic HO row so filters/labels work */
  BRANCHES=[{code:HO_CODE,name:'HO Central Store',city:'',isHO:true}].concat(
    (d.branches||[]).map(b=>({code:b.code,name:b.name,city:b.city||''})));
  BR=BRANCHES.filter(b=>!b.isHO);
  BRANCH_USERS={};BRANCHES.forEach(b=>{BRANCH_USERS[b.code]=b.name});
  HO_MGR='HO Store';

  ITEMS=(d.items||[]).map(i=>({code:i.code,name:i.name,cat:i.cat,type:i.type,unit:i.unit,rate:i.rate,rl:i.rl,pic:'📦'}));
  CATS=(d.meta&&d.meta.cats)||[];
  TYPES=CATS.slice();T_GEN=TYPES[0]||'';T_SPL=TYPES[1]||'';T_STA=TYPES[2]||'';

  VENDORS=(d.suppliers||[]).map(v=>({code:v.code,name:v.name,phone:v.phone||'',alt:'',gst:'',pan:'',
    since:v.since||'',city:v.city||'',addr:'',bank:'',rm:v.rm||'',rmPhone:v.rmPhone||'',email:'',
    terms:v.terms||'',pref:1,level:v.level||'',blocked:!!v.blocked,cats:[],types:[],rating:v.rating||0}));

  PURCHASES=(d.purchases||[]).slice();
  DRAFT_PURCHASES=(d.draft_purchases||d.draft_purchase_invoices||[]).slice();
  DISPATCH=(d.dispatch||[]).slice();
  RETURNS=(d.returns||[]).slice();
  ADJUST=(d.adjust||[]).slice();
  COMPLAINTS=(d.complaints||[]).slice();
  BOOKINGS=(d.bookings||[]).slice();

  /* live stock straight from Bin */
  const hs=d.ho_stock||{};
  for(const k in hs)HO_STOCK[k]=Number(hs[k])||0;

  const bs=d.branch_stock||{};
  for(const k in bs)BRANCH_STOCK[k]=Object.assign({},bs[k]);

  /* Purchase Orders created this month. Pending quantity is qty - received. */
  const pom=d.po_ordered_month||{};
  const ppm=d.po_pending_month||{};
  for(const k in pom)PO_ORDERED_MONTH[k]=Number(pom[k])||0;
  for(const k in ppm)PO_PENDING_MONTH[k]=Number(ppm[k])||0;

  /* safety: any item missing from payload defaults to 0 */
  ITEMS.forEach(function(it){
    if(HO_STOCK[it.code]==null)HO_STOCK[it.code]=0;
    if(!BRANCH_STOCK[it.code])BRANCH_STOCK[it.code]={};
    if(PO_ORDERED_MONTH[it.code]==null)PO_ORDERED_MONTH[it.code]=0;
    if(PO_PENDING_MONTH[it.code]==null)PO_PENDING_MONTH[it.code]=0;
  });

  /* item -> vendor map */
  const iv=d.item_vendors||{};for(const k in iv)itemVendors[k]=iv[k].slice();
  ITEMS.forEach(it=>{if(!itemVendors[it.code])itemVendors[it.code]=[]});

  /* sort transaction arrays newest first (API already does, belt & braces) */
  [PURCHASES,DISPATCH,RETURNS,COMPLAINTS,ADJUST].forEach(A=>A.sort((a,b)=>String(b.date).localeCompare(String(a.date))));

  /* Build once; search/forecast/render paths reuse these maps. */
  DISPATCH_BY_ITEM={};
  DISPATCH.forEach(function(d){(DISPATCH_BY_ITEM[d.item]||(DISPATCH_BY_ITEM[d.item]=[])).push(d)});
  PURCHASES_BY_ITEM={};
  LAST_RATE_MAP={};
  PURCHASES.forEach(function(p){
    (PURCHASES_BY_ITEM[p.item]||(PURCHASES_BY_ITEM[p.item]=[])).push(p);
    if(LAST_RATE_MAP[p.item]==null)LAST_RATE_MAP[p.item]=Number(p.rate)||0;
  });
  SEARCH_ITEMS=ITEMS.map(function(i){return {code:i.code,name:i.name,cat:i.cat,type:i.type,text:(i.code+' '+i.name+' '+i.cat+' '+i.type).toLowerCase()}});
  SEARCH_VENDORS=VENDORS.map(function(v){return {code:v.code,name:v.name,phone:v.phone||'',level:v.level||'',text:(v.code+' '+v.name+' '+v.phone+' '+v.level).toLowerCase()}});
  SEARCH_DISPATCH_BY_REF={};
  DISPATCH.forEach(function(d){if(d.ind)SEARCH_DISPATCH_BY_REF[String(d.ind).toLowerCase()]={item:d.item,label:ITEM(d.item)?ITEM(d.item).name:d.item,where:'indent '+d.ind+' → '+bName(d.branch)};if(d.challan)SEARCH_DISPATCH_BY_REF[String(d.challan).toLowerCase()]={item:d.item,label:ITEM(d.item)?ITEM(d.item).name:d.item,where:'challan '+d.challan+' → '+bName(d.branch)}});
  SEARCH_PURCHASE_BY_REF={};
  PURCHASES.forEach(function(p){if(p.inv)SEARCH_PURCHASE_BY_REF[String(p.inv).toLowerCase()]={vendor:p.vendor,label:VEN(p.vendor).name,where:'invoice '+p.inv};if(p.po)SEARCH_PURCHASE_BY_REF[String(p.po).toLowerCase()]={vendor:p.vendor,label:VEN(p.vendor).name,where:'PO '+p.po}});

  buildDerived();
}

/* --- fetch + boot --- */
function apiCall(args){
  /* Frappe web page context: frappe.call is available; fall back to fetch. */
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    if(window.frappe&&frappe.call){
      frappe.call({method:'stock_indent_360_api',type:'GET',args:args||{},
        callback:r=>resolve(r.message),error:e=>reject(e)});
    }else{
      const q=Object.keys(args||{}).map(k=>k+'='+encodeURIComponent(args[k])).join('&');
      fetch('/api/method/stock_indent_360_api'+(q?'?'+q:''),{headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}})
        .then(r=>r.json()).then(j=>resolve(j.message)).catch(reject);
    }
  });
}

/* =========================================================================
   STORES 360  —  FORECAST BLOCK (dispatch-based, 1-month cover)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Uses HO -> Branch dispatches in the selected report date window.
   Already ordered at HO is subtracted so the same quantity is not ordered twice.
   ========================================================================= */

var FC_COVER_DAYS = 30;

/* Derive the number of days from the current report period/date filter. */
function forecastWindowDays(){
  var p    = dom('fPeriod') ? dom('fPeriod').value : '365';
  var from = dom('fFrom') ? dom('fFrom').value : '';
  var to   = dom('fTo')   ? dom('fTo').value   : '';

  if(p !== 'cust'){
    to   = iso(TODAY);
    from = (p === 'all') ? '2000-01-01' : iso(dAgo(+p));
  }

  var d = daysBetween(from, to);
  if(!d || d < 1) d = 30;

  return {from:from,to:to,days:d};
}

/* Purchase Orders created this month. Pending = qty - received_qty. */
function hoOrdered(ic){
  return Number(PO_PENDING_MONTH[ic]||0)||0;
}

function forecast(ic){
  var it = ITEM(ic), lr = lastRate(ic);
  var w  = forecastWindowDays();

  /* Total quantity dispatched from HO to branches in the selected window. */
  var sentInWindow = 0, sentCount = 0;

  const itemDispatches=DISPATCH_BY_ITEM[ic]||[];
  for(let di=0;di<itemDispatches.length;di++){
    const d=itemDispatches[di];
    if(d.date >= w.from && d.date <= w.to){
      sentInWindow += Number(d.qty) || 0;
      sentCount += 1;
    }
  }

  /* Dispatch rate -> one-month estimated usage. */
  var perDay   = sentInWindow / w.days;
  var perMonth = perDay * FC_COVER_DAYS;

  var ho      = Number(HO_STOCK[ic]) || 0;
  var br      = Number(branchTotal(ic)) || 0;
  var avail   = ho + br;
  var onOrder = hoOrdered(ic);

  /* One-month demand + reorder buffer, then add a 20% safety hike. */
  var baseReq = Math.round(perMonth) + (Number(it.rl) || 0);
  var req = Math.ceil(baseReq * 1.20);

  /* Remove current stock and quantities already ordered. */
  var diff = req - avail - onOrder;

  var pr = 'Not needed', prN = 0;
  if(diff > 0){
    if(MOVE[ic] === 'H' || ho <= (Number(it.rl) || 0)){
      pr = 'Urgent'; prN = 3;
    }else if(MOVE[ic] === 'M'){
      pr = 'High'; prN = 2;
    }else{
      pr = 'Medium'; prN = 1;
    }
  }

  return {
    open: onOrder,
    thisM: sentInWindow,
    lastM: Math.round(perMonth),
    avg: Math.round(perMonth),
    ho: ho,
    br: br,
    avail: avail,
    req: req,
    diff: diff,
    pr: pr,
    prN: prN,
    worth: Math.max(0, diff) * lr,
    rate: lr,

function detect(q){
  q=(q||'').trim().toLowerCase();if(!q)return [];
  const out=[],digits=q.replace(/\D/g,'');
  /* Search only the small master indexes while typing. Transaction IDs use O(1) maps. */
  if(digits.length>=5){
    SEARCH_VENDORS.forEach(function(v){
      const vp=String(v.phone).replace(/\D/g,'');
      if(vp.includes(digits))out.push({k:'vendor',c:v.code,l:v.name,w:'phone '+v.phone});
    });
  }
  SEARCH_ITEMS.forEach(function(i){
    if(i.code.toLowerCase().includes(q))out.push({k:'item',c:i.code,l:i.name,w:i.cat+' · '+i.type});
    else if(i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))out.push({k:'item',c:i.code,l:i.name,w:i.cat+' · '+i.type});
  });
  SEARCH_VENDORS.forEach(function(v){
    if(v.text.includes(q))out.push({k:'vendor',c:v.code,l:v.name,w:v.level+(v.phone?' · '+v.phone:'')});
  });
  const dr=SEARCH_DISPATCH_BY_REF[q];
  if(dr)out.push({k:'item',c:dr.item,l:dr.label,w:dr.where});
  const pr=SEARCH_PURCHASE_BY_REF[q];
  if(pr)out.push({k:'vendor',c:pr.vendor,l:pr.label,w:pr.where});
  const seen=new Set();
  return out.filter(function(o){const k=o.k+'|'+o.c+'|'+o.w;if(seen.has(k))return false;seen.add(k);return true}).slice(0,12);
}

    b.classList.toggle('inlist',inl);b.textContent=inl?'✓ In order list':'＋ Add to order'});
}
function openCart(o){dom('cartDrawer').classList.toggle('on',o);dom('backdrop').classList.toggle('on',o)}
function wireCart(){
  var cb=dom('cartBody');
  if(cb){
    cb.addEventListener('click',e=>{
      const rm=e.target.closest('[data-rm]');
      if(rm){const i=+rm.dataset.rm;const n=CART[i].name;CART.splice(i,1);renderCart();toast(n+' removed');return}
      const q=e.target.closest('[data-q]');
      if(q){const s=q.dataset.q,i=+s.slice(1);CART[i].qty=Math.max(1,CART[i].qty+(s[0]==='+'?1:-1));
        CART[i].worth=CART[i].qty*CART[i].rate;renderCart()}
    });
    cb.addEventListener('change',e=>{const i=e.target.dataset.qi;if(i==null)return;
      const v=Math.max(1,parseInt(e.target.value)||1);CART[+i].qty=v;CART[+i].worth=v*CART[+i].rate;renderCart()});
  }
  var el;
  el=dom('cartBtn');if(el)el.onclick=()=>openCart(true);
  el=dom('cartClose');if(el)el.onclick=()=>openCart(false);
  el=dom('backdrop');if(el)el.onclick=()=>{closeModal();openCart(false)};
  el=dom('cartClear');if(el)el.onclick=()=>{if(!CART.length)return toast('The list is already empty');
    modal('Clear the next order list?','This removes all '+CART.length+' parked items. It cannot be undone.',
      [{label:'Keep list'},{label:'Clear everything',cls:'danger',fn:()=>{CART.length=0;renderCart();toast('List cleared')}}],true)};
  el=dom('cartConfirm');if(el)el.onclick=()=>{
    if(!CART.length)return toast('Add items before submitting');
    const byV={};CART.forEach(c=>{(byV[c.vendorCode]=byV[c.vendorCode]||[]).push(c)});
    const vendorCount=Object.keys(byV).length;
    modal('Submit Next Order',
      '<b>'+CART.length+' items</b> · '+num(CART.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.qty,0))+' units · <b>'+money(CART.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.worth,0))+'</b><br><br>'+      'This will create <b>DRAFT Purchase Order(s)</b>, split by vendor, and send them to the configured <b>Purchase Order approval workflow</b>.<br><br>'+      Object.keys(byV).map(vc=>'· <b>'+esc(VEN(vc).name)+'</b> — '+byV[vc].length+' items, '+money(byV[vc].reduce((s,c)=>s+c.worth,0))).join('<br>'),      [{label:'Cancel'}, {label:'Submit & Send for Approval',cls:'primary',fn:()=>submitNextOrder()}]);
  };
  async function submitNextOrder(){
    if(!CART.length)return toast('Add items before submitting');
    const btn=dom('cartConfirm');
    if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Submitting…';}
    try{
      const cart=CART.map(c=>({item:c.item,qty:Number(c.qty)||0,rate:Number(c.rate)||0,vendor:c.vendor}));
      let result;
      if(window.frappe&&frappe.call){
        result=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>frappe.call({
          method:'create_po_from_indent360',
          args:{cart:JSON.stringify(cart)},
          freeze:true,
          freeze_message:'Creating Purchase Order draft(s)…',
          callback:r=>resolve(r&&r.message?r.message:{}),
          error:reject
        }));
      }else{
        const csrf=(window.csrf_token)||(window.frappe&&frappe.csrf_token)||'';
        const r=await fetch('/api/method/create_po_from_indent360',{
          method:'POST',credentials:'same-origin',
          headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept':'application/json','X-Frappe-CSRF-Token':csrf},
          body:JSON.stringify({cart:JSON.stringify(cart)})
        });
        const j=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw new Error((j&&j.exc)||'PO creation failed');
        result=j.message!==undefined?j.message:j;
      }
      const made=(result&&result.created)||[];
      const errs=(result&&result.errors)||[];
      if(!made.length){
        throw new Error(errs.length?errs.join(' | '):'No Purchase Order was created');
      }
      if(errs.length)void 0;
      /* Create PO, then immediately execute the configured Purchase Order workflow action. */
      const workflowResults=[];
      for(const poName of made){
        try{
          const doc=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>frappe.call({
            method:'frappe.client.get',args:{doctype:'Purchase Order',name:poName},
            callback:r=>resolve(r.message),error:reject
          }));
          await frappe.xcall('frappe.model.workflow.apply_workflow',{
            doc:doc,action:'Send for Approval'
          });
          workflowResults.push({name:poName,ok:true});
        }catch(werr){
          void 0;
          workflowResults.push({name:poName,ok:false,error:(werr&&werr.message)||String(werr)});
        }
      }
      CART.length=0;renderCart();openCart(false);
      const failed=workflowResults.filter(x=>!x.ok);
      if(failed.length){
        toast((made.length-failed.length)+' PO(s) sent for approval; '+failed.length+' transition(s) failed');
      }else{
        toast((made.length>1?made.length+' Purchase Orders':'Purchase Order '+made[0])+' sent to Pending Ops Approval');
      }
      setTimeout(()=>{window.location.href='/app/purchase-order/'+encodeURIComponent(made[0]);},700);
    }catch(err){
      void 0;
      toast('PO submission failed: '+((err&&err.message)||String(err)));
    }finally{
      if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='✓ Submit & Send for Approval';}
    }
  }

  el=dom('cartCsv');if(el)el.onclick=()=>{
    if(!CART.length)return toast('Nothing to export');
    const rows=[['Product Code','Item','Category','Stock Type','Order Qty','Unit','Rate','Est Worth','Suggested Vendor','Level','Priority','Added']]
      .concat(CART.map(c=>[c.item,c.name,c.cat,c.type,c.qty,c.unit,c.rate,c.worth,c.vendor,c.level,c.priority,c.added]));
    dl(rows,'LIFE_Next_Order_List_'+iso(TODAY)+'.csv');toast('Order list exported')};
}
function dl(rows,name){
  const blob=new Blob([rows.map(r=>r.map(x=>'"'+String(x).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(',')).join('\n')],{type:'text/csv'});
  const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=name;a.click()}

/* ---- automatic refresh after 2 minutes without mouse activity ---- */
(function setupIdleRefresh(){
  let lastActivity=Date.now(),refreshing=false;
  const mark=()=>{lastActivity=Date.now()};
  ['mousemove','mousedown','keydown','touchstart','scroll'].forEach(ev=>document.addEventListener(ev,mark,{passive:true}));
  setInterval(async()=>{
    if(refreshing)return;
    const idleFor=Date.now()-lastActivity;
    const drawerOpen=dom('cartDrawer')&&dom('cartDrawer').classList.contains('on');
    const modalOpen=dom('modal')&&dom('modal').classList.contains('on');
    const active=document.activeElement;
    const editing=active&&(active.tagName==='INPUT'||active.tagName==='SELECT'||active.tagName==='TEXTAREA');
    if(idleFor>=120000&&!drawerOpen&&!modalOpen&&!editing){
      refreshing=true;
      try{await loadLive(currentRange());toast('Auto-refreshed · live stock updated');}
      finally{lastActivity=Date.now();refreshing=false;}
    }
  },10000);
})();
